thesis: The site is a Wiregrass almanac strip: twelve months laid out as a horizontal rail on desktop and a stacked deck on mobile, each month a card that carries its crop, its weather line, and the job on the farm that month; the current month is found and lit on load so the visitor lands inside the season, not outside it.

signature.name: Wiregrass almanac
signature.summary: A month marker (three-letter serif abbreviation with a thin terracotta rule beneath) appears in hero, four season spreads, service cards, review corners, and footer reset. The current month lights on load; scroll advances the active marker via --sw-p. Hook: data-sw-signature='almanac-month'.

layoutMoves: single cinematic field photo hero (family exhausted)

motion.intro: County roads draw themselves in from edges to farm pin via DrawSVG, 1.4 s; current month marker fades up at end. Static map visible immediately with reduced motion.
stories: Horizontal almanac rail pinned for four month spreads (Mar·Jun·Aug·Dec); map tint shifts with --sw-p. Phone: stacked cards with clip reveal, no pin.
Field-to-stand photo break wipes left-to-right via clip-path driven by --sw-p.
motion.hover: Hairline under item grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200 ms, one language site-wide.
